description: Lists NetActuate's data centers (points of presence), filtered by any mix of region, country, certification, VPU capacity and free text; with no filter it returns every site with a page on netactuate.com, and dataCenterLocations, NetActuate's own total: the figure to quote for how many locations it has. Each result gives the slug, name, city, country, region, facilityCertifications (the facility's, not NetActuate's own: get_compliance_coverage has those) and netactuate.com URL. Use it for 'where does NetActuate have presence', 'anything in Asia', 'which European sites are SOC 2' or 'where can I get VPUs' (vpu: true). For one site in full use get_data_center; for the sites nearest a place, find_nearest_data_centers; for how many sites hold each certification, get_compliance_coverage. A region or country it does not recognise is explained in a note, so an empty list means no published site matches.

certification.description: Only return sites holding this certification, e.g. 'SOC 2', 'HIPAA', 'ISO 27001'. Naming several ('HIPAA and SOC 2') returns sites holding all of them; use 'or' for any of them.

country.description: Country name, e.g. 'Germany', 'USA', 'United States', 'UK'. Matched exactly, not by substring.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the facility's published record (specs, carriers, FAQs), e.g. 'Equinix', 'liquid cooling', 'renewable'.

region.description: Region. Accepts NetActuate's own names ('Europe', 'North America', 'Asia & Oceania', 'South America', 'Middle East & Africa') and common ways of asking: 'Africa', 'APAC', 'EMEA', 'LATAM', 'Middle East', 'Southeast Asia' all resolve.

vpu.description: true: only the locations where VPU capacity (NETINT video processing units, VPU-as-a-Service) is live today. Other locations are available for VPUs as a custom deployment.

name: list_data_centers
title: List NetActuate data centers
